test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A student scores 80 marks in a subject with a weightage of 3 and 90 marks in another subject with a weightage of 2. What is the weighted average score of the student?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Weighted Average** = (Value₁ × w₁ + Value₂ × w₂) ÷ (w₁ + w₂)

Sum = (80 × 3) + (90 × 2) = 240 + 180 = 420

Total Weight = 3 + 2 = 5

Weighted Average = 420 ÷ 5 = 84

**∴ The correct answer is 84 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Score 1 = **80** (Weightage = **3**), Score 2 = **90** (Weightage = **2**).

**Formula Used:** Weighted Average = Σ (Weight × Score) ÷ Σ (Weight)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8522bb348f12ea2b38e805f32edcbd3dca378ccbdd17fbdcd133d4fb5e1b91f4.png] 

⇒ Total Marks = (80 × 3) + (90 × 2)

⇒ Total Marks = 240 + 180 = 420

⇒ Total Weightage = 3 + 2 = 5

⇒ Weighted Average = 420 ÷ 5

⇒ Weighted Average = 84

**∴ The correct answer is 84 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Formula

It is calculated as (w₁x₁ + w₂x₂ + ... + wₙxₙ) ÷ (w₁ + w₂ + ... + wₙ), where x represents values and w represents their respective weights.

Comparison with Simple Average

A **Simple Average** is a special case of the weighted average where all weights are equal (w₁ = w₂ = ... = wₙ).

Combined Mean

If two groups have sizes n₁, n₂ and averages x₁, x₂, the **Combined Mean** is (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).</p
